'''August 2001 Massachusetts tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Massachusetts in August 2001. [[Eric Hunter]] won it. It is known from Eric Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2878">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-21-domination-of-the-menud2878/ domination-of-the-menu], DeckTech (Eric "bounty22" Hunter, 21 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-21-domination-of-the-menud2878/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' August 2001
* '''Site:''' Massachusetts
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Eric Hunter]]
